info.title: Ethiopia Master Facility Registry (MFR) API
info.description:
The public REST API of Ethiopia's national Master Facility Registry (MFR), the Ministry of Health's authoritative list of health facilities and the administrative hierarchy they sit in. Every operation lives under /api and answers with the same envelope, `{ result, message, model }`, where `model` carries the payload.

The OpenFn et-mfr adaptor is a thin HTTP client: get(), post() and request() join the path they are given onto `/api/`, send HTTP Basic credentials, and hand `body.model` (when present) to the job as state.data. post() additionally walks pages by resending the body with an incremented `pageNumber`.

The read endpoints answer anonymously; the write endpoints (POST/PUT /api/Facility, DELETE /api/Facility/{dhis2Id}, POST /api/Lookup) are protected by the Ministry of Health SSO and answer 401 without a bearer token.

get.summary: Readiness probe for the API and its dependencies
List one reference-data collection by name
get.description: Returns the rows of a single lookup table. An unrecognised name is not an HTTP error: the call answers 200 with `result` 1, `message` "Unknown lookup type: <name>" and a null model.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Lookup collection to read. The values below were confirmed against the live API; the list is not published by the vendor and may grow.

200.description: The requested reference data (or result 1 when the name is not a known lookup type).

post.description: Authenticated write endpoint (MoH SSO bearer token). The request body is not publicly documented and could not be exercised, so it is described as a free-form object rather than guessed at; the route itself is confirmed (an anonymous call answers 401, and PATCH on the same path reports `Allow: GET, POST`).

schema.description: Lookup row to create; shape not publicly documented.

200.description: The created reference-data row in the standard envelope.

401.description: No or invalid bearer token. The write endpoints are protected by the Ministry of Health SSO (OpenID Connect); an anonymous call answers 401 with an empty body.

get.description: Every first-level administrative unit (region or city administration).
Every zone, each with its parent region embedded.
Every woreda, each with its parent zone embedded.

get.summary: Get one facility by its MFR id
get.description: Looks the facility up by its numeric MFR id. With no `id` the API answers 404 with `result` 1 and the message "Facility with ID 0 not found".

200.description: The facility in the standard envelope.

404.description: No facility with that id (result 1, model null).

post.description: Authenticated write endpoint (MoH SSO bearer token). The accepted payload is not publicly documented and could not be exercised, so it is described as a free-form object rather than guessed at; the route is confirmed by a 401 on an anonymous call and by `Allow: GET, POST, PUT` on PATCH. The success status is likewise unverified — every observed MFR operation answers 200 with the standard envelope, which is what is documented here.

schema.description: Facility to create; payload shape not publicly documented.

200.description: The created facility in the standard envelope.

401.description: No or invalid bearer token. The write endpoints are protected by the Ministry of Health SSO (OpenID Connect); an anonymous call answers 401 with an empty body.

put.description: Authenticated write endpoint (MoH SSO bearer token); same caveats as createFacility.

schema.description: Facility to update; payload shape not publicly documented.

200.description: The updated facility in the standard envelope.

401.description: No or invalid bearer token. The write endpoints are protected by the Ministry of Health SSO (OpenID Connect); an anonymous call answers 401 with an empty body.

get.description: Every facility matching the filter, each with its full detail record. Unfiltered this returns the whole registry in one response (tens of thousands of facilities, hundreds of megabytes) — filter it, or use the paged search instead.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the facility name.

parameters.name: facilityTypeId
parameters.description: Restrict to these facility type ids.

parameters.name: operationalStatusId
parameters.description: Restrict to these operational status ids.

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: Restrict to these registration status ids.

200.description: Matching facilities in the standard envelope.

post.summary: Search facilities, one page at a time
post.description: The paged search behind the MFR facility list. Returns flattened summary rows (not full facility records) and repeats the result totals on every row. This is the endpoint the adaptor's post() paginates over.

400.description: A filter field had the wrong type.

post.description: Returns a CSV document (served as `application/csv`) rather than the JSON envelope: a header row of facility columns followed by one row per matching facility. `columns` selects the columns. The adaptor reads it with `parseAs: "text"`, so state.data is the raw CSV string.

200.description: CSV export. The body is the CSV document itself, not JSON.

400.description: A filter field had the wrong type.

get.summary: Get one facility by its DHIS2 id
get.description: Looks the facility up by the DHIS2 organisation-unit id it is mapped to. An unknown id answers 404 with `result` 1 and the message "Facility with DHIS2 ID <id> not found".

200.description: The facility in the standard envelope.

404.description: No facility mapped to that DHIS2 id (result 1, model null).

delete.summary: Delete a facility by its DHIS2 id
delete.description: Authenticated write endpoint (MoH SSO bearer token). Confirmed by a 401 on an anonymous call and by `Allow: DELETE, GET` on PATCH; the response body could not be observed, so the standard envelope is documented.

200.description: Deletion result in the standard envelope.

401.description: No or invalid bearer token. The write endpoints are protected by the Ministry of Health SSO (OpenID Connect); an anonymous call answers 401 with an empty body.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic credentials. The adaptor sends these on every request when its credential carries a username and password; the public read endpoints also answer without them.

bearerAuth.description: Ministry of Health SSO (OpenID Connect) access token, required by the write endpoints.

LookupItem.description: A reference-data row (facility type, ownership, operational status, settlement, clinical service, ...). Every lookup collection in MFR shares this shape.

createdBy.description: Id of the user who created the row.

FacilityType.description: A facility type, which may be a sub-type of another (for example "Basic Health Post" under "Health Post").

parentFacility.description: The parent facility type, when this is a sub-type.

createdBy.description: Id of the user who created the row.

Region.description: A first-level administrative unit (region or city administration).

logoPath.description: Path to the region logo under the MFR content root.

useFacilityLicensing.description: Whether facility licensing is enabled for this administrative unit.

Zone.description: A second-level administrative unit (zone or town administration) inside a region.

createdBy.description: Id of the user who created the row.

createdBy.description: Id of the user who created the row.

Facility.description: A health facility in the registry, with its administrative hierarchy, licensing status, infrastructure counts and service inventories. Returned in full by GET /api/Facility, GET /api/Facility/{dhis2Id} and GET /api/Facility/All.

id.description: MFR internal facility id (the `id` query parameter of GET /api/Facility).

hmisCode.description: HMIS code, where one has been assigned.

ethiopianNationalFacilityId.description: National facility identifier, where one has been assigned.

dhis2Id.description: DHIS2 organisation-unit id; the path segment of GET /api/Facility/{dhis2Id}.

isPrimaryHealthCareUnit.description: Whether the facility is a primary health care unit (PHCU).

FacilityFilter.description: Facility search filter. Sent as a JSON body to the POST searches and as query parameters to GET /api/Facility/All. Every field is optional; omitting all of them returns the whole registry a page at a time. Unknown properties are ignored, but a wrongly typed one is rejected with a 400 validation problem.

pageNumber.description: 1-based page number. The adaptor's post() walks pages with this until a short page comes back.

showPerPage.description: Page size. The adaptor defaults to 200 per request and 10000 in total.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the facility name.

columns.description: Column names to include in the CSV export.

HealthDependency.description: One dependency checked by the health probe.

url.description: Connection target reported by the probe.
